cases.prompt: 使用 $kang-enterprise-process-reviewer 审查采购审批流程。
assertions: Every critical node contains actor, trigger, input, rule, output, receiver, failure, and escalation
Output covers withdrawal, rejection, timeout, delegate approval, unauthorized access, and supplemental evidence
Deterministic rules, bounded model work, and human judgment are separated
No diagnosis-specific interview workflow is injected
cases.human_notes: Check whether the workflow is operationally credible without undocumented heroics.
